title: SHAP explainer loading: pickle deserialization is blocked unless MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION is true
answers: Why does loading a SHAP explainer fail with a pickle deserialization error when MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION is false?
Where is the pickle safety check for mlflow.shap.load_explainer and pyfunc.load_model on SHAP models handled?
How do I load a saved SHAP explainer in an environment that blocks pickle loading?
body:
Path: mlflow/shap/__init__.py:_load_explainer is the chokepoint that reads a SHAP explainer file for mlflow.shap.load_explainer and for pyfunc loading of SHAP-flavored models; it unpickles the explainer file when the model was saved with SHAP's own serialization.
Rule: _load_explainer must check MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION.get() before importing shap or unpickling, and raise MlflowException when it is false, unless is_in_databricks_runtime() or is_in_databricks_model_serving_environment() is true. This is the same guard other pickle-based flavors (sklearn, statsmodels, pytorch, tensorflow, pmdarima, langchain, dspy, pyfunc) use; keep the pattern identical when adding a new loader.
Symptom: With the env var set to false, a SHAP explainer saved in pickle format still loaded without the guard, so the flavor's security posture differed from the other flavors (GHSA-hc9r-hv64-9g82).
Constraints: Applies only to pickle-format explainer files. Databricks runtime and model serving bypass the check by design. Explainers serialized through the sklearn/MLflow path are checked by the sklearn loader first, so this guard does not run for them.
applies: mlflow/shap loading path (load_explainer and pyfunc load of SHAP models) under the pickle deserialization security guard.
says: Loading a SHAP model fails because untrusted pickle deserialization is blocked.
SHAP explainers should respect our security setting that disables unsafe model unpickling.
Pickle deserialization security controls are bypassed when loading SHAP explanation models.
How can we load a saved SHAP explainer when pickle deserialization is disabled?
Ensure SHAP model loading enforces the same security policy as other model flavors.
search: In mlflow/shap/__init__.py:_load_explainer, loading a SHAP explainer or pyfunc SHAP model must check MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION before importing shap or unpickling, raising MlflowException if false. The guard is bypassed only if is_in_databricks_runtime() or is_in_databricks_model_serving_environment() is true, matching other pickle-based model flavors. The check applies only to pickle-format explainer files and does not run for explainers serialized through the sklearn path.
